The Fifth Sun, called 4-Movement, is the fifth and current cosmic age of Aztec myth, born at Teotihuacan when the humble god Nanahuatzin threw himself into a divine fire to become the new sun, later named Tonatiuh. Aztec tradition holds this age, unlike the four before it, will end in earthquakes, a fate encoded in the day-name Movement itself.
